title: On limit sets and equicontinuity in the hyperspace of continua in dimension one
summary: The paper studies the structure of $ω$-limit sets of map $\tilde{f}$ induced on the hyperspace $C(G)$ of all connected compact sets, by dynamical system $(G,f)$ acting on a topological graph $G$. In the case of the base space being a topological tree we additionally show that $\tilde{f}$ is always almost equicontinuous and characterize its Birkhoff center.
